name: Dallas Laird
prior_offices: Natrona County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; listed among current officers on the official elected officials page)
background: Dallas Laird is a Natrona County commissioner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. Oil City News reported that he finished second in the three-seat race with 13,071 votes, behind Ray Pacheco and ahead of Matt Keating.
